# Safe Swimming School

> In-home private and semi-private swim lessons at the family's pool across Palm Beach County and surrounding areas. West Palm Beach is welcome.

Safe Swimming School comes to the family's home pool or community pool. Swim lessons are private, or semi-private when siblings learn together. There are no group swim lessons. Water aerobics is a separate group class.

Founder Cortney Berry has 20 years of experience, and cofounder Anson Ainsworth has 18. Instructors are certified, and the school is fully insured.

Lessons run 8 AM to 7 PM every day. A swimmer has the same instructor every lesson. The school is happy to sign an NDA for families who want privacy.

Ages start at 3 months. Infants begin with a parent in the water.

Packages are 8 lessons for $520, 12 lessons for $720, and 20 lessons for $1,100, plus annual registration of $35 for one swimmer, $50 for two siblings, and $60 for a family with three or more swimmers. Water aerobics is $45 per 30-minute group class.
Single lesson: $75 (can be credited toward a package).

Phone: 561-236-8260

## Service area

Lessons are available across Palm Beach County, including West Palm Beach and surrounding areas. These town pages are examples, not a limit. If a town is not listed, ask.

- [Locations](https://safeswimmingschool.com/locations/): Palm Beach County and surrounding areas
